body:
I wouldn't consider using `typeof` to be expected to affect these checks, it would be little different from adding some custom method that does a check, the specifics are documented [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/static_typing.html#common-unsafe-operations-and-their-safe-counterparts)

Expanding this to `typeof` would be a lot more complicated, the `is` operator is a language feature, but the `typeof` method is not integrated like that, also there's no type safety conditions for `match`

This is a relatively limited feature, but I don't see any of these cases being cases that can't be achieved using these methods for type safety

For some of the autocomplete issues please check existing issues or create new ones, as that might be bugs  separately from this
